anime_multiverse.companion.disabled: The companion system is switched off (companions.enabled).
anime_multiverse.companion.join.full: You already have as many companions walking with you as you can.
anime_multiverse.companion.bond.put: Put what I am holding in the pouch
anime_multiverse.companion.bond.use.on: Let her use the pouch on me when I am hurt
anime_multiverse.companion.bond.use.off: Do not let her use the pouch on me
She will look after you from the pouch when you are hurt.
She will leave the pouch alone.
anime_multiverse.companion.bond.pouch.lo: The pouch is for the one she walks with, or for a friend while she walks with nobody.
anime_multiverse.companion.charmy.sub: Cotton and Food Mage of the Black Bulls
anime_multiverse.companion.charmy.greet: Oh, %s! Did you bring snacks? ...I mean, hello!
anime_multiverse.companion.charmy.q.food: What do you like to eat?
anime_multiverse.companion.charmy.a.self: I'm Charmy Pappitson of the Black Bulls! Cotton Magic and Food Magic, that's me. And if you've got food, you're my favourite person.
anime_multiverse.companion.charmy.a.food: Everything! But cake, pumpkin pie and cookies most of all. Ask me what I like if you want the whole list.
anime_multiverse.companion.charmy.a.magi: Cotton Magic: fluffy, soft and stronger than it looks. And Food Magic, which is the best kind of magic there is.
anime_multiverse.companion.charmy.a.join: Yay, an adventure! Is there food on the way? Lead on!
anime_multiverse.companion.charmy.a.wait: Okay, I'll wait right here. Don't be gone long!
anime_multiverse.companion.charmy.join.n: Share a snack with me first. Then we can talk about walking together.
anime_multiverse.companion.charmy.join.t: I'm walking with someone else right now.
anime_multiverse.companion.charmy.use: Here, have this %s! You look terrible!
anime_multiverse.companion.charmy.gift.l: %s! For me? You're the best, I love you!
anime_multiverse.companion.charmy.gift.o: Thanks! %s is not bad at all.
anime_multiverse.companion.charmy.gift.h: Ugh... %s? Even I won't eat that.
anime_multiverse.companion.charmy.stance: I'll stay out of it. Promise.
anime_multiverse.companion.gs.story.none: Nothing yet. Talk, give gifts, walk together.
anime_multiverse.companion.gs.put_hint: Click an item to hold it, then Put
anime_multiverse.companion.gs.hint.bond: Drag an item onto her portrait to give it.
anime_multiverse.companion.gs.tip.portra: She seems pleased that you looked at her.
anime_multiverse.companion.gs.tip.gift_s: The gift slot: click to pick an item from your inventory.
anime_multiverse.companion.gs.tip.give: Give her the chosen item. Her answer shows what she thinks of it.
anime_multiverse.companion.gs.tip.meter: Rapport grows when you talk, give gifts she likes and walk together. The leaves light at 3, 10 and 25.
All three leaves are lit. She counts you a close friend.
anime_multiverse.companion.gs.tip.mood: How she feels right now. It follows what you say and give.
anime_multiverse.companion.gs.tip.follow: She walks with you. Click to ask her to wait here.
She is waiting here. Click to ask her to walk with you.
anime_multiverse.companion.gs.tip.ring.r: She has something in the pouch to use when you are hurt (under two fifths of your health, at most every 30 seconds).
anime_multiverse.companion.gs.tip.ring.e: The switch is on, but the pouch holds nothing she would use. Put a healing potion or food in it.
anime_multiverse.companion.gs.tip.ring.o: The switch is off. She will leave the pouch alone.
anime_multiverse.companion.gs.tip.ring.l: The pouch is not open to you now, so there is no switch.
She loved this when you gave it.
She liked this when you gave it.
She hated this when you gave it.
anime_multiverse.companion.gs.ev.heal: She looked after you from the pouch
